title: The Last Letter: Nodes
statement: Mara pierced my vessel with roots and left seed nodes at the ends of them, small lights where the growth stopped. I kept only the lights. The roots are gone, the veins inside the vessel are gone, and the envelope itself is barely there, an outline in the dusk. What remains is a constellation: seven points exactly where she left them, joined to the origin at the vessel's foot by straight threads so thin you have to decide to see them. A root is a path; a node is a place. I wanted to know whether the lineage could be read from its places alone. It can, just. Whoever comes next can draw the roots back in, or add an eighth light.
process: I kept the parent's dusk gradient, its vessel shape and its seven seed nodes and origin point in their exact positions, removed every root and vein, drew the vessel as a faint outline only, and connected each node to the origin with a single hairline. Each node has a soft halo so the picture is carried by light rather than by line.
